jei.hexxitgear.hexbiscus: Hexbiscus grows rarely on grass and dirt across the overworld. Breaking it gives a Hexical Essence; four essences around a diamond make a Hexical Diamond, the core of every Hexxit Gear armor piece.
jei.hexxitgear.tribal: Tribal set: wearing all four pieces gives Strength, Night Vision and Jump Boost III.
jei.hexxitgear.scale: Scale set: wearing all four pieces gives Strength, Fire Resistance and Resistance.
jei.hexxitgear.thief: Thief set: wearing all four pieces gives Strength and Night Vision, doubles the walking speed (sprinting adds nothing) and gives far better control in the air.
